senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. מִשְׁפָּחָה) [attached to the household,] handmaid, slave.—ש׳ חרופה, v. חֲרוּפָה.—
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:2">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>נטלו … לו ש׳ לשמשו</he> they took a rib from him (Adam), and gave him a handmaid to wait on him.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 99b:8">Ib. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>מוטב תהא ש׳ לאומה זו וכ׳</he> better for her to be a handmaid to this nation than a mistress to any other nation.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 3:12">Kidd. III, 12</cite> <he>ולד ש׳ ונכרית</he> the child of a slave or of a gentile woman.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 3:13">Ib. 13</cite> <he>ממזר שנשא ש׳ וכ׳</he> if a bastard married a slave, their child is a slave.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 69a:1">Ib. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>האומר לשִׁפְחָתוֹ וכ׳</he> if one says to his bondwoman, be thou free, but thy child (with which thou goest) shall be a slave, the child follows her status (is free).

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:5">Keth. V, 5</cite> <he>הכניסה לו ש׳ אחת וכ׳</he> if the wife brought him one slave, she need not grind, or bake &c.; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U01729"><he>שְׁפָחוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:5">Ib.</cite> <he>אפי׳ … מאה ש׳ וכ׳</he> even if she brought him a hundred slaves, he may force her (his wife) to work in wool &c.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:1">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>, a. e. <he>ש׳ מכודנות</he>, v. <cite ref="K00142"><he>כָּדַן</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Vayetsé 8 <he>לא תהא … הש׳</he> should not my sister Rachel be at least like one of the handmaids (Bilhah and Zilpah)? <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:7">Ab. II, 7</cite>; a. fr.
